title: 3D Visualization of Fourier Series
difficulty_analysis: L4 challenges: (1) correct mathematical calculation of Fourier series coefficients; (2) 3D implementation of chained epicycle rotation (center-to-endpoint cascading); (3) extrusion of the waveform trace along the Z-axis with a rolling window; (4) online calculation of the L2 norm error; (5) synchronized updating of the coefficient bar chart; (6) state consistency when dynamically adjusting the speed/term count
